title: Chaihu-Shugan San ameliorates perimenopausal obesity with depression by coordinately targeting hepatic PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma signaling and gut barrier integrity.
authors: Chen, Qiliang; Liu, Jian; Wang, Junqiao; Yin, Ting; Wu, Yedi; Zhang, Tianpeng; Yu, Fangjun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药柴胡疏肝散改善围绝经期肥胖伴抑郁的代谢与肠道屏障机制，核心为肝脏脂代谢通路与炎症，无蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模内容，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Perimenopausal obesity and depression are highly prevalent and debilitating comorbidities in aging women, yet effective integrative treatment options remain limited. Chaihu Shugan San (CHSGS), a classic traditional herbal formula, has long been utilized in clinical practice for treating perimenopausal symptoms and mood disorders. However, whether CHSGS exerts therapeutic efficacy in perimenopausal obesity with depression (POD), and the mechanisms underlying its actions remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the therapeutic effects of CHSGS on POD and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: A POD mouse model was established by combining ovariectomy (OVX), chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS), and a high-fat diet (HFD). CHSGS efficacy was assessed through biochemical analysis, organ indices, and a battery of behavioral assays. Serum and hepatic triglycerides (TG), total cholesterol (TC), and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) were quantified, and hepatic steatosis was evaluated using hematoxylin-eosin and Oil Red O staining. RNA sequencing was performed to identify differentially regulated pathways, followed by qRT-PCR and Western blot validation. UPLC-HRMS and network pharmacology were used to identify core bioactive constituents and putative targets. Molecular docking further characterized interactions between major compounds and key proteins. RESULTS: POD mice developed obesity, loose stools, and pronounced anxiety- and depression-like behaviors. CHSGS treatment markedly alleviated these pathological manifestations, reduced hyperlipidemia, and improved hepatic steatosis and glucose intolerance. CHSGS decreased systemic and hepatic TG, TC, and LDL-C levels, and improved histopathological scores. Transcriptomic profiling indicated that the metabolic benefits of CHSGS are associated with modulation of the PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma axis. Subsequent qRT-PCR and Western blot analyses confirmed that CHSGS reversed POD-induced dysregulation of the PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma pathway. Integrated analyses further revealed that CHSGS upregulated the tight-junction protein Occludin, thereby enhancing intestinal barrier integrity, reducing systemic inflammation, and mitigating depression-like behaviors. Molecular docking identified glycyrrhizic acid, naringin, and naringenin as principal bioactive constituents with strong affinities for the core targets. CONCLUSION: CHSGS ameliorates POD through a coordinated, multi-target mechanism involving restoration of hepatic lipid metabolism via regulation of the PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma pathway, and reinforcement of intestinal barrier function through Occludin-mediated suppression of systemic inflammation. These findings highlight CHSGS as a promising holistic therapeutic approach for POD, reflecting the multi-component and multi-pathway pharmacological characteristics of traditional formulas.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：围绝经期肥胖与抑郁是老年女性中高发且致残的共病，但有效的综合治疗方案仍然有限。柴胡疏肝散（CHSGS）作为一种经典中药复方，长期在临床上用于治疗围绝经期症状和情绪障碍。然而，CHSGS是否对围绝经期肥胖伴抑郁（POD）具有治疗作用，及其作用机制尚不清楚。研究目的：评估CHSGS对POD的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法：通过结合卵巢切除术（OVX）、慢性不可预见性轻度应激（CUMS）和高脂饮食（HFD）建立POD小鼠模型。通过生化分析、器官指数和一系列行为学实验评估CHSGS的疗效。定量检测血清和肝脏中的甘油三酯（TG）、总胆固醇（TC）和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C），并使用苏木精-伊红染色和油红O染色评估肝脏脂肪变性。进行RNA测序以识别差异调控通路，随后通过qRT-PCR和Western blot验证。使用UPLC-HRMS和网络药理学识别核心生物活性成分和推定靶点。分子对接进一步表征主要化合物与关键蛋白之间的相互作用。结果：POD小鼠出现肥胖、稀便以及明显的焦虑和抑郁样行为。CHSGS治疗显著缓解了这些病理表现，降低了高脂血症，并改善了肝脏脂肪变性和葡萄糖不耐受。CHSGS降低了全身和肝脏中的TG、TC和LDL-C水平，并改善了组织病理学评分。转录组学分析表明，CHSGS的代谢益处与PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma轴的调节相关。随后的qRT-PCR和Western blot分析证实，CHSGS逆转了POD诱导的PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma通路失调。综合分析进一步揭示，CHSGS上调紧密连接蛋白Occludin，从而增强肠道屏障完整性，减少全身炎症，并缓解抑郁样行为。分子对接确定甘草酸、柚皮苷和柚皮素为主要生物活性成分，与核心靶点具有强亲和力。结论：CHSGS通过协调的多靶点机制改善POD，涉及通过调节PGC-1alpha/CYP8B1/PPARgamma通路恢复肝脏脂质代谢，以及通过Occludin介导的全身炎症抑制增强肠道屏障功能。这些发现突显了CHSGS作为POD的一种有前景的整体治疗方法，反映了传统复方多成分、多通路的药理学特征。
